mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, plan_id, sku_id, status, auto_renew, start_time, current_period_start, current_period_end, benefit_anchor_time, next_renew_time, grace_end_time, cancel_at_period_end, cancel_time, pending_plan_id, pending_sku_id, pending_effective_time, provider, agreement_no, plan_snapshot_json, source_order_no, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted FROM ai_user_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('active', 'canceling', 'past_due') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.account, s.plan_id AS planId, p.plan_name AS planName, s.sku_id AS skuId, sku.sku_name AS skuName, s.status, s.auto_renew AS autoRenew, s.cancel_at_period_end AS cancelAtPeriodEnd, s.current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, s.current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, pending_plan.plan_name AS pendingPlanName, s.create_time AS createTime FROM ai_user_subscription s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_membership_plan p ON p.id = s.plan_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_membership_plan_sku sku ON sku.id = s.sku_id AND sku.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_membership_plan pending_plan ON pending_plan.id = s.pending_plan_id AND pending_plan.deleted = 0 WHERE ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
